title: 32 Malasaña Street
description: The Olmedo family leaves village life behind to move to an apartment in Madrid, where something horrifying awaits them.

title: From Black
description: A recovering addict is presented with the chance to learn what happened to her missing son.

title: Castle Freak
description: Terror strikes when a blind woman and her friends travel to a mysterious Albanian castle that harbors dark secrets.

title: Devil's Candy
description: A struggling painter is possessed by satanic forces after he and his family move into their dream home.

title: The Noonday Witch
description: A mother and daughter start a new life in a remote house. When the daughter discovers that her mother has lied about her father, their relationship begins to wither.

title: A Banquet
description: A widowed mother is radically tested when her teenage daughter insists a supernatural experience has left her body in service to a higher power.

title: Pyewacket
description: A frustrated, angst-ridden teenage girl awakens something in the woods when she naively performs an occult ritual to evoke a witch to kill her mother.

title: The Room
description: A couple discover a strange room in their new house that grants material wishes, but all they want is a child.

title: Satan's Slaves
description: After dying from a strange illness that she suffered for three years, a mother returned home to pick up her children.

title: Satan's Slaves: Communion
description: Several years after saving themselves from a terrible incident, Rini and her younger siblings Toni and Bondi live with their father in flats. They believe living in flats with many people is safe, but this may not be true.

title: Son
description: When a young boy falls ill to a mysterious illness, his mother must decide how far she will go to protect him from terrifying forces in her past.

title: Speak No Evil
description: On a vacation in Toscana, a Danish family instantly becomes friends with a Dutch family. Months later, the Danish couple receives an unexpected invitation. It doesn't take long before the joy of reunion is replaced with misunderstandings.

title: The Wind
description: When a frontierswoman in the 19th-century wilderness begins to sense a sinister presence, her dread is dismissed by her husband. But a newlywed couple arrives, amplifying fears and setting a shocking chain of events into motion.

title: The Dark and the Wicked
description: Plagued by waking nightmares, two siblings suspect that something evil is taking over their family at an isolated farmhouse.

title: Color Out of Space
description: After a meteorite lands in the front yard of their farm, Nathan Gardner and his family find themselves battling a mutant extraterrestrial organism that infects their minds and bodies, transforming their quiet rural life into a technicolor nightmare.

title: The Clovehitch Killer
description: After Tyler finds a cache of disturbing images in his father's possession, he begins to suspect that the man he trusts most in the world may be responsible for a series of unsolved murders.

title: Hunter Hunter
description: A fur trapper leaves his wife and daughter behind to kill a rogue wolf in the remote wilderness. But they soon become increasingly worried when a severely injured man shows up to disrupt their peaceful existence.

title: Consecration
description: After the suspicious death of her brother, a priest, Grace travels to the Mount Saviour Convent in Scotland to find out what really happened. Once there, she uncovers murder, sacrilege and a disturbing truth about her own past.

title: The Queen of Black Magic
description: A middle-class family travels into rural Indonesia to visit the terminally ill director of the orphanage where the father was raised as a child. Sinister and terrifying events soon befall them and the other visiting families.

title: What Josiah Saw
description: After two decades, a damaged family reunite at their remote farmhouse, where they confront long-buried secrets and sins of the past.

title: Lingering
description: Yoo-mi falls into unexpected mystery and horror while searching for her mother's friend at a hotel to drop off her younger sister.

title: Metamorphosis
description: A face-changing evil spirit infiltrates a family, placing one brother in danger while the other tries to save him.

title: Anything for Jackson
description: A sinister couple hatch a supernatural scheme to resurrect their dead grandson through a pregnant woman.

title: The Babadook
description: A troubled widow (Essie Davis) discovers that her son is telling the truth about a monster that entered their home through the pages of a children's book.

title: Daddy's Head
description: A boy and his widowed stepmother find themselves in fear for their lives after they are visited by an unexplainable creature which appears to mimic the boy's recently deceased father.

title: The Banishing
description: The story of the most haunted house in England. In the 1930s, a young reverend, his wife and daughter move into a manor that holds a horrifying secret.

title: The Cellar
description: A woman must confront an ancient and powerful entity after her daughter mysteriously vanishes in the cellar of their new home.

title: A Dark Song
description: A young woman and a damaged occultist risk their souls to perform a ritual.

title: The Pact
description: Disturbing visions and her sister's disappearance lead a woman (Caity Lotz) to call a cop (Casper Van Dien) and a psychic to her childhood home.

title: The Pact II
description: A woman plagued by nightmares of a serial killer learns her dreams have a horrifying connection to the real world.
